csv_project_name: Design for MD 611 East Side Shared Use Path Phase 1
csv_scope_of_work: Worcester County is issuing this Request for Proposals (RFP) for a qualified experienced consultant or consultant team to provide professional engineering design, permitting and bid phase services for design of the first phase of a shared use path along the east side of MD 611. The project will connect the existing shared use path at US 50 and extend south approximately 1.3 miles to Mystic Harbour Blvd. The Consultant Firms shall be proficient in the services listed in this RFP and shall bring an experienced and expert staff to the contracts as required. Firms interested in being considered must submit a complete Standard Form (SF) 330 concurrent with the technical proposal.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
csv_comments: '- Project Number: BPM057609- Pre-Submittal Meeting: 07/08/2026 10:00 AM EDT- Pre-Submittal Location: Worcester County Public Works Administration Building at 6113 Timmons Road, Snow Hill, MD.- Pre-Submittal Attendance: Recommended- Solicitation documents available online. Pre-Bid meeting July 8 at 10:00 AM EDT

project_scope: Professional engineering design, permitting, and bid-phase services for Phase 1 of a shared-use path along the east side of MD 611. Requested disciplines include civil, geotechnical, structural, utility, traffic design, and traffic studies.
services: Professional engineering design, permitting, and bid-phase services; likely multidisciplinary civil infrastructure design including structural, geotechnical, utility, and traffic engineering. Submission requires SF 330 with technical proposal.
relevance_explanation:

- Limited indication of innovative structural design, sustainability features beyond standard active mobility infrastructure, or significant structural complexity.

references_qualifications: Qualified and experienced consultant or consultant team required. Firms must be proficient in the listed services and provide experienced expert staff. Interested firms must submit a complete Standard Form (SF) 330 concurrent with the technical proposal.
